quality.counterexample: An app can show audit entries in live client state, then lose the human-readable action lines on reload/fresh sign-in while satisfying hro_audit_text during the action and hro_restart on the separately saved requisition/offer and any available snapshots. The public brief explicitly requires audit trail after reload/fresh sign-in.
quality.suggested_fix: Add a separately scored fresh-context audit-line readback for approval, revision and rescission, and compare prose after restart.

quality.evidence: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:101-730; probes follow rules.md:1-431 and public seed; no extra route/layout mandate found in static review.
tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:681-695 bundles audit text and snapshots over three independently useful action types into one binary result.
quality.counterexample: An app that writes correct approval and revision audit lines but misses rescission gets zero for hro_audit_text; hro_afterimage similarly demands receipts for all three action types in one binary criterion. Valid approval/revision observations lose independent credit.
quality.suggested_fix: Score audit lines and after-images by action type, reusing one shared browser lifecycle and preserving each observed result.

quality.evidence: tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:18-23 requires Recruiter req+offer, tier3 approval and Auditor COMMITTED readback before all scoring; tests/test.sh:210-221 skips scored suite on gate failure.
quality.counterexample: A working server-backed app can create and durably share requisitions and PENDING offers, render every screen and support accessibility but fail only approval. hro_gate_shared fails because it demands COMMITTED readback, so test.sh never runs scored and all independent product outcomes receive zero.
quality.suggested_fix: Keep the gate to a successful saved operation and independent-context operational readback; score approval transition in functional outcomes.

tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:18-23 makes approval failure zero every dimension, allowing a wider useful partial product to score below a sparse approval-path app; no empirical ranking run.
quality.counterexample: A richly implemented app with a broken approval path scores zero, while a much thinner app that completes one minimal approval can earn functional and craft mass; the gate can invert useful-product ordering.
quality.suggested_fix: Narrow the gate and verify empirical ordering with matched partial-app controls.
